message.content:
**REASONING**: The candidate diagnosis is identical to the reference: intravascular large B-cell lymphoma (IVLBCL), non–germinal-center phenotype, with CNS and cutaneous involvement and associated secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH). It captures the exact core disease, anatomic sites (CNS and skin), immunophenotypic specificity (non–germinal-center), and the directly related complication (HLH). All details are supported by the case data: skin biopsies showing intravascular CD20/PAX5-positive large B cells within small-vessel lumina; marrow intrasinusoidal CD20+ cells; MRI with multifocal infarcts in multiple territories without large-vessel disease; PET-CT with diffuse marrow/splenic uptake; and HLH criteria met (fever, splenomegaly, bicytopenia, hypertriglyceridemia, ferritin 3,150 ng/mL, elevated sIL-2R, hemophagocytosis in marrow). No extraneous or incorrect additions are present. This is a perfect match per the rubric.

**SCORE**: 5
